text:
anya: quick heads up — Zephyr (preview) will be pushed to staging Monday AM. Can we run a token/sec impact sanity check?

mike: thanks, what are the traffic assumptions for preview? will it be opt-in or open to all orgs?

anya: opt-in early testers only. expected 1k daily active users at first, peak 120 concurrent sessions during tests. avg tokens/request ~1.2k (long prompts).

leo: rough calc: 120 concurrent * 1.2k tokens * 1 req/sec per session ~= 144k tokens/sec sustained during peak. that’s higher than early estimates.

marie: whoa. we usually size staging at ~20-30k t/s. 144k will saturate current inference pool. cost and GPU hours will balloon.

anya: yep — want recommendations on mitigation: smaller batch size? priority routing to cheaper quantized shards? region gating?

mike: can we throttle preview traffic with rate limits on the route? for experiments we can cap to 0.5 req/sec per session to spread load.

leo: if we cap to 0.5 r/s then load halves to ~72k t/s. still big but closer. also can pin preview to smaller GPU types with higher concurrency (quantized A100-ish).

marie: quick cost sketch (very rough): 72k t/s for 2 hours = tokens: 72k*3600*2 = 518M tokens. At $0.0004 per 1k tokens -> ~$207.2 for that window on hosted. But GPU reserved costs differ.

sre-oncall: network/egress note: APAC customers in preview will route via singapore. our singapore cluster has lower spare GPU headroom (only ~10% free). If we put traffic there we risk interfering w/ Dedicated customers.

anya: good catch. prefer to keep preview in us-west/us-east only for now. exclude apac until we have more capacity.

leo: ops plan options:
```
- Option A: Route preview to dedicated quantized pool (Q-pool) in us-west. Requires provisioning 8 extra small inference nodes (~4xA100-equivalent) for 48 hours.
- Option B: Global throttle + pin to hosted burst capacity, no provisioning, but higher per-token spend and possible queuing.
- Option C: Canary with synthetic traffic first to validate perf, then staggered rollout (best safety).
```

mike: timeline: can we get synthetic perf test tomorrow? I can seed 10k synthetic users over 2 hours to mimic shape.

leo: I can spin up canary infra and run perf test. estimate provisioning lead time for Q-pool nodes ~3 hours.

marie: if we go Q-pool route we should double-check billing code path and alerting: add token-level billing tag "zephyr-preview" and a cost watch alert at $500/day.

anya: agreed. also add quality rollback hook: if median latency > 700ms or error rate > 2% revert to fallbacks.

devops-bot: deploy-plan created: #deploys/zephyr-preview -> canary infra -> notify @eng-sre. CI job 2456 queued.

sre-oncall: FYI I’ll block APAC region routing for this route until we confirm capacity. Also will add temporary quota: route_max_rps=60 for the preview org.

mike: status after tomorrow's synthetic run we can decide. Thanks everyone — please post perf summary in this thread. :thumbsup:
